entities.summary: Enslaved Population, Vodou, and Resistance, a transformative movement in Haiti (1700–1789). Emerged from Sugar Revolution and the Plantation System and Treaty of Ryswick 1697 cedes western Hispaniola to France. Catalyzed Gens de Couleur Libres and Colonial Social Hierarchy and Saint-Domingue enslaved population reaches approximately 500,000 by 1789.
